cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — chest-deep in the water; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a starship data archive — standing; A bright public weather exhibit with a shallow demonstration channel and sunlit glass ceiling — Dressed for the exhibit as an imaginary current reader; A nearly empty civic tram car crossing broad salt flats under a gray-white sky — She spends a rare unhurried commute watching a line of bright mineral pools pass the window while peeling one small orange; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — fans a folding fan open between her hands; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake at chest height; her bedroom — perched on a ledge or edge; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — kneeling on the ground; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
